packageRules.description: Every bump also moves files derived from the pins
prBodyNotes: The `renovate-followup` workflow commits the files derived from the pins (Weaver checksums, the manifest's `schema_url`s, `model/`, `out/`, `docs/registry/`) to this branch. If it fails, rerun it once its GitHub App secrets (`RENOVATE_FOLLOWUP_APP_ID`, `RENOVATE_FOLLOWUP_APP_KEY`) are set: a commit made by hand on this branch stops Renovate updating it (CONTRIBUTING.md, "Dependency bumps").
